description: Amending Land Use Codes for Natural Infrastructure Planning is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by 1000 Friends of Wisconsin; City of Port Washington, Wisconsin; Orion Planning + Design. Learn how a Sea Grant agent is working with one community to audit and amend its existing land use codes and ordinances to be more inclusive of green infrastructure projects. Coverage: the United States (2023). The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
